radar-beta:
  axis a, b, c, d, e
  curve c1["Clipped"]{0, 20, 150, 60, 100}
  curve c2["Inside"]{10, 30, 50, 70, 90}
  min 10
  max 100
  ticks 3

            10                                   100
            |------------+------------+------------|
  a Clipped ........................................  0
    Inside  ........................................  10

  b Clipped ####....................................  20
    Inside  =========...............................  30

  c Clipped ########################################  150
    Inside  ==================......................  50

  d Clipped ######################..................  60
    Inside  ===========================.............  70

  e Clipped ########################################  100
    Inside  ====================================....  90
